name: fm-1-fmb-vocal
author: shan-sherif
tagline: a physically modelled singing voice for the M-VAVE FM-1
description: A simulated human voice: lungs, vocal folds, throat, mouth and nose, an airway that sings. Type words and the keys sing them a syllable at a time or on built-in tunes, play vowels and shape the mouth and tongue with the knobs, blend the male, female and child bodies, beatbox with a step sequencer, or play the seal, songbird, alligator and elephant. Voice engine based on CHIMERA by Jameson Hodge (MIT). Unofficial; not affiliated with M-VAVE, and not endorsed by CHIMERA's author.
credits: Voice engine based on CHIMERA by Jameson Hodge (MIT, github.com/jamesondh/chimera-vocal-synth), on fm1-base by Charles Vestal and felucca-bsp by Leo Kuroshita (MPL-2.0).
